if (temp > MIN_DAMAGE_TEMPERATURE) { double damageRate = Math.min(temp, MAX_DAMAGE_TEMPERATURE) / (MIN_DAMAGE_TEMPERATURE * 10); reactorDamage += damageRate; } else { double repairRate = (MIN_DAMAGE_TEMPERATURE - temp) / (MIN_DAMAGE_TEMPERATURE * 100); reactorDamage = Math.max(0, reactorDamage - repairRate); }
rules.topic: Fission damage accrual and repair per tick
rules.value: Above 1200K: damage += min(temp,1800)/12000 per tick — 0.10/t at 1200K (full damage in ~50 s), 0.15/t at 1800K+ (~33 s). Below 1200K damage slowly repairs: (1200-temp)/120000 per tick. There is very little reaction time once the damage zone is entered; cooling must be automatic, not manual.

When damage >= 100 AND temperature >= 1200K: each tick rolls meltdownChance (default 0.001, scaled by damage/100) — expected ~1000 ticks (~50 s) at exactly 100% damage. A meltdown is an explosion of radius 8 (default) PLUS a radiation release with the contents' radioactivity multiplied by 50 (meltdownRadiationMultiplier default); reactor damage then resets to 75. If meltdownsEnabled is false, the reactor instead force-disables until damage drops. The logic adapter's DAMAGED/TEMPERATURE redstone modes exist precisely to SCRAM before this point.

rules.topic: Logic adapter redstone modes usable as a SCRAM interlock
rules.value: The fission logic adapter can emit redstone on TEMPERATURE (reactor at/above the 1200K damage threshold) and DAMAGED (damage at 100) among its modes. Wiring TEMPERATURE mode to cut fuel insertion / stop the reactor is the intended automatic safety path; a bot monitoring task should treat 1200K as a hard alarm line, not a warning.

rules.topic: Fusion reactor ignition/burn threshold and injection cap

value.note: The reaction burns fuel only while plasma temperature >= 100,000,000 K (line 209). MAX_INJECTION = 98 is the GUI's effective injection-rate cap (FusionReactorMultiblockData.java:63). Ignition means depositing enough laser energy to push the plasma to the burn temperature; below it the plasma only cools.

rules.topic: Supercritical Phase Shifter antimatter cost (config defaults)

value.note: Defaults: 1000 mB of polonium input and 1 GJ of energy per 1 mB of antimatter. Both values are server config; verify live before quoting a production plan.
